built_pages_note: Lap 18 (2026-09-08T0249Z). RE-MEASURED, not inherited: 23 pages under Carlito, page objects and page-tree /Count both 23, after this lap ran the apt line paper/README.md records; the digest f2ee9be6c9c7c4e0 was printed by the run that measured the SHIPPED document, after the repairs below. 8,995 -> 8,994 body words; margin against the 9,000-word proxy 5 -> SIX. THE LAP'S INDEPENDENT REVIEWER BLOCKED, THE BLOCK WAS RIGHT, AND WHAT IS RECORDED HERE IS THE REPAIRED VERSION. WHAT THE LAP DID. The incorporated diff (64f015b..c456da7, ten files outside paper/ and docs/auto/) made no manuscript sentence false: §2's NIFoS clause was already at its narrowed wording, docs/related_work.md rows 13-14 now agree with it, and WC-009 and WC-010 were each registered inside the lap that withdrew them, so §3.5's 'three times' is unchanged (the reviewer re-derived that independently from the commits). NO NEW ARTIFACT UNDER data/processed/, so no result section gained a number, a table or a figure, and all nine figures re-rendered BYTE-IDENTICALLY. F9_present_perimeter is still drawn, committed and NOT referenced (GAPS.md G8, NH-032 open). Gap count unchanged at 7. THE WORK WAS THE ITEM LAP 17'S REVIEWER FILED WITHOUT FIXING. Fifteen of 29 references were verified 'via the Crossref record' -- a catalogue entry -- while §2 characterised six of them substantively. The incorporated diff registers WC-009 against exactly that move ('never a flat present-tense sentence about what a system does, in EITHER direction, when the only thing opened is a catalogue record or a newspaper'), so the paper was applying one provenance standard to the Korean operational systems and a laxer one to the Western evacuation-routing literature, and check_paper.py:203 cannot see it because it tests only for the substring 'verified'. Twelve abstracts were opened in full and quoted verbatim into their notes (OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar and arXiv routes, each named in the note that used it). FOUR COULD NOT BE OPENED and are marked CATALOGUE RECORD ONLY -- dozier1981, cova2003, li2017, li2019; nifos2026guide is the fifth and was already so. Three sentences were narrowed to what their titles support, the sharpest being li2019's 'so it accounts for the time evacuation takes', which is in nothing that was opened AND is partly foreclosed by cova2005's own abstract already taking 'estimated evacuation time' as an input. Two more were moved onto opened text and two compressions were themselves corrections. THE NOTES COST NOTHING: build_docx.py's fmt_ref does not render the note field, so provenance for sixteen references was bought at zero words and zero pages. WHAT THE REVIEWER KILLED, AND IT WAS THE ONE SENTENCE THE LAP ADDED. The draft wrote, in Data and code availability, 'Each reference's note says what was opened; five rest on catalogue records.' ROOT OBJECTION: that is a flat universal over 29 notes written by a lap that had rewritten 17 of them, and it is FALSE for four -- firms and era5 carried the entire note 'verified 2026-09-03' (19 characters, no URL clause, no statement of what was opened), and worldcover and osm stated a fact about the source without saying what was opened. The sentence advertising the correction was the thing that was now wrong, which is the WC-005 and WC-009 shape exactly: the lap chose which entries to correct and missed one. SECOND OBJECTION, INDEPENDENTLY FATAL: 'five' was the only new number in the diff and is UNREGISTERED -- no docs/NUMBERS.json key covers it, build_numbers.py never reads references.bib, no gate re-derives it -- and it sat one line below the manuscript's own 'Every measured number is registered in docs/NUMBERS.json'. CHARTER §3.3: a number you cannot register, you do not write; CHARTER §12 forbids this routine from registering it. Both halves of the sentence had to go. It now reads 'references.bib marks each work known only from a catalogue record' -- no universal over the notes, no numeral, and checkable by grepping CATALOGUE RECORD ONLY. THE FOUR THIN NOTES WERE THEN FIXED RATHER THAN ONLY THE SENTENCE: firms, era5, worldcover and osm were re-opened at their URLs this lap and now record what the page states. THE REVIEWER'S SHARPEST FINDING WAS A HOLE THE NARROWING ITSELF OPENED. Dropping 'the Korean local area' from §2 left §4.8's 'still a few alarms a day at a two-minute cadence' with NO STATED SOURCE anywhere in the paper, and the kim2021gk2a note asserted that §3.1 supplied it when §3.1's whole GK2A sentence named no sector and no cadence. That is the WFG-171 circle in reverse -- a bib note certifying a repair the manuscript does not contain -- inside the lap whose subject is precisely that. §3.1 now reads 'GK2A level-1B radiances from its two-minute Korean local-area sector', sourced NOT to the cited paper but to this repository's own ingestion: src/wildfireguardian/detection/gk2a.py names the LA sector 'every 2 minutes at 2 km in the infrared' and builds AMI/L1B/LA/ keys with area la020ge, and docs/gk2a_direction_experiment.md records 'FD 10-min, LA 2-min'. TWO FURTHER NOTE DEFECTS THE REVIEWER FOUND, BOTH DESYNCHRONISATIONS OF THE KIND THIS LAP IS ABOUT. dozier1981's note justified §2's wording as 'the title's own subject'; the title's subject is surface temperature FIELDS of subpixel resolution and neither 'area' nor 'two-component' appears in it, so the note's reasoning was wrong even though the sentence is not -- both §2's and §4.8's phrases describe this repository's own computation with the paper cited for the method's origin, and the note now says that and says the attribution is conventional. studenski2011's note quoted §2's OLD wording ('an established predictor of') which the same lap had already changed to 'predicts survival'. WHAT THE REPAIRS COST: net +2 against the draft, 8,992 -> 8,994, margin 8 -> 6. WHAT THE REVIEWER CLEARED: no manuscript number has a wrong value; check_paper, check_number_collisions, check_withdrawn_claims (10 claims over 933 gated files) and check_forbidden all green; the five CATALOGUE RECORD ONLY sentences are each held to their reference's title; 'three times' survives; no other manuscript sentence went false from the incorporated diff. WHAT WAS DECLINED FOR THE SIXTH LAP RUNNING: the §3.5 illustration that registration keeps finding live copies a hand sweep missed, which now has its best instance -- WC-009's registration found a copy in a file the reviewer had passed as clean. About 20 words against the 6 this lap ends with. NH-037 IS THE ANSWER AND IT IS STILL OPEN.
